Mapping tracking minted token balances per user address.
Constructor that stores marketAddress and instantiates the Oasis market.
Payable function that credits locked[msg.sender] with msg.value.
Mints tokens for msg.sender using the current market price.
Burns tokens from the caller balance.
View function returning the ETH value of a user token balance.
Returns locked ETH to msg.sender via transfer.
Computes the price rate from the best Oasis offer between weth and dai.

msg.sender.transfer(payout) external ETH transfer in withdraw.
External call to market.getBestOffer(weth,dai) returning an offer id.

edges.reason: Constructor stores the addr parameter into marketAddress.
Constructor uses addr to instantiate the Oasis market instance.
Constructor controls initialization of the market state variable.
msg.sender indexes locked in deposit and withdraw.
msg.sender indexes tokenBalance in mint, burn and withdraw checks.
deposit updates the locked mapping for the caller.
mint performs the amount*1e18/currentPrice multiplication.
mint amount parameter flows into the mint arithmetic expression.
currentPrice local flows into the mint division.
mint arithmetic result is assigned to the tokens local.
Computed tokens are added into tokenBalance[msg.sender].
mint writes the caller token balance.
burn writes the caller token balance.
burn amount parameter is subtracted from tokenBalance.
withdraw executes the external ETH transfer to the caller.
msg.sender is the recipient of the transferred payout.
payout local is the transferred amount.
locked[msg.sender] is read into the payout local.
withdraw zeroes locked[msg.sender] before transferring.
getPrice calls market.getBestOffer to obtain the offer id.
getPrice calls market.getOffer with the retrieved id.
weth is passed as the sell gem to getBestOffer.
dai is passed as the buy gem to getBestOffer.
Offer id returned by getBestOffer is stored in id.
id is passed as the argument to getOffer.
getOffer returns payAmt into the payAmt local.
getOffer returns buyAmt into the buyAmt local.
getPrice performs the buyAmt*1e18/payAmt multiplication.
payAmt local flows into the getPrice arithmetic expression.
buyAmt local flows into the getPrice arithmetic expression.
getPrice arithmetic result is assigned to the rate local.
tokenValue performs the tokens*currentPrice multiplication.
user parameter indexes tokenBalance in tokenValue.
tokenBalance[user] is read into the tokens local.
getPrice result is stored in the currentPrice local of tokenValue.
tokens local flows into the tokenValue multiplication.
currentPrice local flows into the tokenValue multiplication.
tokenValue arithmetic result is assigned to the value local.
External Oasis market call to getBestOffer can execute external code affecting getPrice.
External Oasis market call to getOffer can execute external code affecting getPrice.
Transfer of ETH to msg.sender could re-enter withdraw.

normalization_plan.reason: addr parameter is only consumed by the constructor when setting the market.
amount parameter is only used in mint to compute tokens.
amount parameter is only used in burn to reduce tokenBalance.
user parameter is only used in tokenValue to read tokenBalance.
currentPrice local exists only inside the mint function body.
tokens local exists only inside the mint function body.
payout local exists only inside the withdraw function body.
id local exists only inside the getPrice function body.
payAmt local exists only inside the getPrice function body.
buyAmt local exists only inside the getPrice function body.
rate local exists only inside the getPrice function body.
tokens local exists only inside the tokenValue function body.
currentPrice local exists only inside the tokenValue function body.
value local exists only inside the tokenValue function body.
